pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal regions with moderately sharp edge gradients. Patches on the upper flank are larger and more elongated, while patches transitioning toward the ventral and posterior regions show reduced spatial area and higher frequency.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous mesh of light-colored pathways separating dark patches. Junction nodes predominantly connect three to four patches. Pixel thickness of the corridors is relatively uniform across the mid-torso area.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-profile mane along the dorsal ridge exhibiting a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette against the background.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: A distinct, circular nodule with textural disruption and hyper-pigmented characteristics is visible on the upper posterior flank near the rump.
